Jules (Support): Escalating pilot for Redwood partner RidgePath. Two issues: SSO users seeing 'redirect loop' and bulk ingest returning 413 on large batches. Trial renewal review in 9 days. Ticket INC-7401.
Kara (CS): Thanks Jules. Need quick repro + account id. Is 413 from our gateway or client side?
Jules (Support): account=ridge-77. Sample gateway log: "413 Payload Too Large" for batch_size=250. Single item calls OK. SSO: 3 users stuck after Okta redirect. Logs attached.
Ben (AE): RidgePath is evaluation-stage with potential enterprise seat expansion. We need CS to stabilise POC; ops bump and short extension might be needed.
Mina (Solutions): Likely two fixes: bump max_payload for pilot tenants and add SameSite cookie tweaks on IdP callback. Short-term: reduce default batch to 50 and enable chunked uploads. I'll open a runtime PR.
ops-bot: Ops approved 48h trial extension and one-time throughput bump for ridge-77.
Rita (Customer): Appreciate fast turnaround. Prefer config change rather than code edits on our side. Zoom tomorrow morning works. Success metrics: no 413s for 200-doc batches, dashboard access for all invited users.
Kara (CS): Plan: owner=Kara, ops-extension=48h, solutions=deploy batch default change (ETA 6h), infra=IdP cookie patch (ETA 4h), schedule enablement call tomorrow 9am PT. I'll draft customer comms now.
Mina (Solutions): Runtime patch merged to canary; running RidgePath sample next.
Jules (Support): Added repro script and attached customer sample to ticket.
Kara (CS): Will capture feedback after call and update docs (bulk ingest best practices). Notify AE if any regression. :memo:
